axes.label: Wellbeing
axes.description: The person's own state: energy, pace, recovery. Positive = a pace they can keep up, genuine time off. Negative = strain they describe in themselves. Reads the PERSON, not the situation: a team that is not delivering, a slipping date, a broken handover or deadline pressure only touch this axis if they say how it is landing on them. A calm account of a hard situation is not distress; score that under clarity.

axes.label: Engagement
axes.description: Motivation, ownership, investment in the work. Positive = leaning in, proposing ideas, taking initiative. Negative = going through the motions, coasting, quiet disengagement.

axes.label: Clarity
axes.description: Role clarity, priorities, alignment with the team and manager. Positive = knows what matters this week and why. Negative = vague priorities, unclear expectations, noise.

axes.label: Growth
axes.description: Trajectory, learning, stretch. Positive = stretching, learning fast, getting the right feedback. Negative = plateau, bored, not being invested in.
